model_annotation: Quintuplets are native inhabitants of a nominally agnostic religious landscape in a subset of India, often found to have markedly different reproductive and vocational patterns from their predominantly Hindu population. In 2021, quintuplets accounted for 16% of enterprises, with the construction sector employing a disproportionate 51% of their workforce. Additionally, quintuplets held an unusual share of 33% net turnover, with a noticeable concentration in the construction industry.
